g.text: Level-pool routing links stage-storage and stage-outflow curves through a time-step balance
Hypothetical stage ratings S=3600h,O=h in stated SI units. Modified Puls/trapezoidal continuity: S₂−S₁=(Δt/2)(I₁+I₂−O₁−O₂),Δt=600 s. Table uses a separate40-minute
illustrative inflow sequence, not the four-hour hydrograph in866. Initial h=0. End storage need not vanish when inflow ends.
